text: ann: Heads-up — the embedded preview iframe on /kb/runtime/quickstart is returning a 403 for some users, noticed from the onboarding flow. Anyone own that page or the embedded asset? :confused: seb: I'll take a quick look :eyes: which embed? can you paste the URL? ann: https://kb.internal/runtime/quickstart — it's the preview iframe that used to show the short walkthrough video, now gets 403 for non-prod users. Saw it in user-replay 2026-03-18. deploy-bot: [automated scan] crawl-failure: /kb/runtime/quickstart iframe src https://cdn.partner-host/video123.mp4 -> 403 (suspicious) maria: likely the CDN token rotated. quick mitigation is to swap the iframe to a rehosted static poster image until we get the signed URL fixed. small PR, low risk. ann: OK — can someone open a tiny PR to replace the iframe with the poster image + link to full video (so onboarding still works)? jason: @ann I can open the PR, will do the poster swap and add a TODO to re-enable iframe once CDN fix done. estimated 10–15m. maria: snippet you can use: ```html ``` or use this sed to change in-place if it's a single file: ```bash sed -n '1,200p' docs/kb/runtime/quickstart.md | sed 's//<\/a>/g' > tmp && mv tmp docs/kb/runtime/quickstart.md ``` jason: thanks, will push branch and ping for CR when ready. tagging @lisa for CODEOWNERS note — we should add docs owners for that folder if there's none. lisa: good call, I'll check CODEOWNERS and add a small entry if needed. also leave a short changelog note in the PR. :+1: ann: awesome, thanks all. please paste the PR link here when ready so I can queue the onboarding release. :pray: jason: PR opened — https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4823 brief description and changes, cc @ann @maria ann: verified in staging preview, poster shows and link opens video. great, approved. :thumbsup: lisa: added CODEOWNERS entry in the same PR to docs-team so future edits route correctly. ann: marking this resolved for the onboarding run — leaving the TODO to re-enable iframe once partner rotates the signed token. will follow up with partner ops. :sparkles:
